# karaswang.github.io — deploy artifact, do not edit directly

This repo is the published copy of Kara Wang's site, served by GitHub Pages.
It's generated by `deploy.sh` from the separate `karaswang-site` repo, which
overwrites this repo's files on every deploy.

**Make all edits in `karaswang-site`, not here** (including this file —
it's generated from `karaswang-site`'s `README-FOR-GITHUB-PAGE.md`).
